panel_description_zh: 中景平视，客卧门被推开到 45 度角（不是撞开）；门框里妻子半身站立在门槛，一只手扶门把手；脸是 3/4 侧面，能看到蹙眉；表情生气但没有吼叫；门框外走廊顶灯暖白光。
character_anchors_invoked: character_妻子_生气.json#expression-v1（平静数落版，不是吼叫）

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 不是李斌，我说你多少次？尿尿把那个马桶盖打开

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot from the hallway side looking into the guest-bedroom door being pushed open to about 45 degrees by a normal opening motion, not slammed. In the door frame a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman stands half-body at the threshold, one hand resting on the brushed-silver doorknob. Face shown in three-quarter side view, eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge forming a settled scowl, eyes narrowed, mouth closed, jaw clenched — but the overall intensity is the calm scolding of an inspection, not the rage of the previous page. Long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top tucked into light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fluffy-cuff light grey memory-foam house slippers, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand on the doorknob. Hallway ceiling light warm white from upper right, cool blue-grey bedroom interior beyond. Mood: the inspection has begun, the door of Act II is open. Text watermark 'P05-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in bed, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, anime anger vein marks
